entry_title: Antonio Williams landing spot in Washington
entry_text: Antonio Williams landing spot in Washington. Opportunity available, high-upside 2024 offense with Jayden Daniels, undersized but solid separator, high-end freshman contributor in ACC, potential Week 1 slot and 2WR-set role.

Rams played 13 personnel more than any team in the last decade, strong passer rating in 13 personnel, heavy TE sets as possible offensive meta, potential WR target consolidation in 2WR-heavy structures, examples include JSN/Seahawks and Puka/Rams.

Post-draft stock up/down watchlist. Stock up: Antonio Williams, Chris Bell, Zachariah Branch, Malachi Fields, Ja'Kobi Lane, Carson Beck, Drew Allar, Oscar Delp, Jadarian Price, Ty Simpson, Titans RBs, Giants RBs, Commanders RBs, Darnell Mooney, Xavier Worthy. Stock down: Makai Lemon, Denzel Boston, Omar Cooper Jr., Kenyon Sadiq, Eli Stowers, Jerry Jeudy, Michael Pittman, Zach Charbonnet, Harold Fannin, Juwan Johnson, Hunter Henry. Treat this as market/reaction signal, not scoring truth.

Round 1 QBs since 2000 with fewer than 650 career college pass attempts and fewer than 1,000 rushing yards includes Carson Wentz, Mark Sanchez, Ty Simpson, Mac Jones, Mitch Trubisky, Dwayne Haskins. Treat as low-experience/developmental variance candidate, needs verification.
Data-savvy Jaguars drafted Tanner Koziol in Round 5. TIBER had his model edge at +18.
